body:
Thanks for the bug report! Unfortunately, the information you provided is likely insufficient to understand the cause of the issue and fix it, if there's an engine bug involved.

Are you sure you checked the correct script? Sometimes it's easy to get them confused when you have multiple similar scripts. I've encountered a couple of cases where a separate script file would become a duplicate built-in script for some reason. Also, please note that in tool mode (tool scripts, editor plugins), the debugger is inactive, so breakpoints won't work.

Is there any way to reproduce the bug (if you want to)? For example, by switching to an earlier commit? Note that the bug may be in the editor cache (the `.godot` folder, which isn't tracked in the repository). If so, you could probably fix the bug by deleting the cache rather than recreating the script. In that case, the ability to reproduce the bug is likely lost. But I would assume that something changed when the script was recreated (i.e. the problem is not in the cache).

Unfortunately I don't have any earlier versions left. I too suspect that deleting `.godot` could have fixed the issue. If the problem reemerges, I'll try that.
